steps: Gather your documents: Aadhaar card (Age/Address proof) and a passport size photo.
Visit voters.eci.gov.in or open the Voter Helpline App.
Fill out 'Form 6' with your details and upload the scanned documents.
Submit the application and save the 'Reference ID' for tracking.
Wait for field verification by the Booth Level Officer (BLO).
Receive your physical EPIC card via post after approval.
voter_registration.followup: Would you like to know how to track your status?

steps: Go to your designated Polling Booth with your EPIC card or a valid ID.
The first polling official will check your name on the electoral roll.
The second official will mark your finger with indelible ink and give you a slip.
The third official will take the slip and enable the Balloting Unit.
Enter the voting compartment, press the blue button on the EVM next to your candidate's name.
Wait for the beep and check the VVPAT slip behind the glass for verification.
voting_process.followup: Do you need help finding your polling booth?

steps: Download the 'cVIGIL' app from the Play Store or App Store.
Select the type of violation (e.g., money distribution, hate speech).
Capture a photo or record a short video of the incident.
Submit the report. Your GPS location is automatically attached.
Track the status. ECI teams usually arrive within 100 minutes.
mcc_violation.followup: Would you like to know more about MCC rules?

steps: Login to the Voters' Service Portal or Voter Helpline App.
Select 'Form 8' for Correction of Entries/Shifting of Residence.
Choose what you want to correct (Name, Age, Address, Photo, etc.).
Upload the supporting document for the correction (e.g., birth certificate for age).
Submit and track using the Reference ID.
